"Create a complete, playable martial arts combat strategy game inspired by Martial Arts Brutality.

CORE GAMEPLAY

The game is a tactical turn-based martial arts fighting game combining collectible technique cards, strategic combat decisions and real-time reaction challenges.

COMBAT SYSTEM

- Two fighters face each other in a detailed side-view combat arena.
- Combat alternates between attack and defense phases.
- During the attack phase, the player selects technique cards from their hand.
- Each card represents a different martial arts move, including punches, kicks, blocks, counters, throws, pressure-point strikes and special techniques.
- Executing a technique triggers a directional swipe or timing-based reaction challenge.
- Successful execution determines the attack's accuracy, damage and effectiveness.
- During the opponent's attack phase, the player must react to incoming attacks by swiping in the correct direction or timing a defensive action.
- Allow perfect blocks, dodges, counters and failed defenses.

BODY DAMAGE SYSTEM
Create a detailed anatomical damage system.
Different attacks target different body parts:

- Head
- Neck
- Chest
- Heart
- Abdomen
- Arms
- Legs
- Joints

Damage to specific body parts must have gameplay consequences. Injured arms reduce offensive effectiveness, damaged legs affect mobility, and head or torso damage affects stamina and consciousness.

Include multiple knockout conditions and cinematic finishing animations.

CARD SYSTEM
Create a collectible card system with:

- Basic techniques
- Advanced martial arts techniques
- Defensive techniques
- Counterattacks
- Chi energy abilities
- Rare and legendary forbidden techniques

Each card must have its own artwork, description, energy cost, damage, effects and rarity.

Players can build and customize their own combat decks.

MARTIAL ARTS STYLES
Include distinct fighting styles:

- Shaolin Kung Fu
- Wing Chun
- Shotokan Karate
- Taekwondo
- Muay Thai
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu

Each style must have unique techniques, advantages, weaknesses and animations.

PROGRESSION
Create a progression system featuring:

- Experience and character levels
- Unlockable techniques
- Card collection and upgrades
- Character attributes
- Skill trees
- New opponents and increasingly difficult challenges
- Tournament progression
- Rewards and achievements

VISUAL DESIGN
Use a gritty, mature martial arts aesthetic.
Create detailed human fighter models with fluid combat animations, impactful strikes, realistic reactions, dynamic camera effects and dramatic knockout sequences.

The combat interface should clearly display fighter health, stamina, Chi energy, injured body parts, available cards and turn indicators.

GAME MODES
Include:

1. Single-player campaign.
2. Training mode.
3. Survival mode with increasingly difficult opponents.
4. Tournament mode.

IMPORTANT TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
Build an actual playable game, not a static mockup.
Implement functional cards, combat calculations, turn management, animations, enemy AI, damage states, victory and defeat conditions.

Start with a fully functional single-player combat experience featuring one playable fighter, one AI opponent, a deck of at least 15 cards, attack and defense phases, and a complete damage system.

Prioritize functional gameplay over visual complexity.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
